description: This file contains unit tests for the PdfSharp library, specifically testing the BouncyCastleSigner implementation for signing PDFs, including creating new PDFs and signing existing PDFs, with test setup, certificate handling, and rendering signature appearance.

classes.name: BouncyCastleSignerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing PDF signing functionalities using BouncyCastleSigner, implementing IDisposable to reset state after tests.

methods.name: BouncyCastleSignerTests
methods.description: Constructor that resets the PDFsharp core state and sets font resolver if in core mode.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Resets the PDFsharp core state after tests.

methods.name: Sign_new_file_Bouncy
methods.description: Test method to create a new PDF, apply a digital signature with signature appearance, and save the file.

methods.name: Sign_existing_file_Bouncy
methods.description: Test method to open an existing PDF, apply a digital signature, and save the result.

methods.name: GetCertificate
methods.description: Loads a certificate and certificate collection from a PFX file for signing.
